name: channel-1
title: OpenMSA Introduction: Governed Decentralized Data Spaces
description:
OpenMSA is an open-source managed-space architecture for governed, decentralized data spaces.

This short introduction covers:
- Why OpenMSA is not a filesystem abstraction
- Gateway-first secure access design
- Identity signing, stateless authorization, local index lookup
- Write-only inbox and policy-based resource access

Project:
https://github.com/surajkumar8642/openmsa

If you are building safer B2B data exchange, this is a practical reference implementation.

Repo status is public and actively evolving.
